detail_text: SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE 2026-SPRDL126R0076 Item Name: Motor, Ball Screw AC NSN: 6105-01-136-0964 Part No: (088K1) J-16116-20 Base Period Quantity: 65 EA Option Period Quantity: 130 EA End Item: M860A1 Patriot Trailer The Government will does not have a Technical Data Package (TDP) for this product.
